title: Substack API Scraper – Posts, Full Text & Comments
description: Scrape any Substack newsletter into JSON/CSV: posts with full text, comments, or the category leaderboard itself (rank, subscriber counts, pricing), no post scraping needed. No login, no browser, no start fee. Full text from $0.002, leaderboard rows from $0.0005.
seoTitle: Substack Scraper API – Posts, Text & Leaderboard
seoDescription: Scrape Substack posts, full article text, comments, and category leaderboard rankings with subscriber counts and pricing — JSON/CSV, no login required.

result.eventDescription: One Substack post returned to the dataset with its full article text or HTML body.

post-metadata.eventDescription: One Substack post returned without its article body — charged instead of the full-text price when includeBodyText and includeBodyHtml are both off.

leaderboard-row.eventDescription: One publication returned from a discoverCategories leaderboard (rank, subscriber counts, author, subscription prices) when leaderboardOnly is on — no post scraping, no article-body request.

comment.eventDescription: One Substack comment returned to the dataset (only charged when includeComments is on).
